title: The ladle does not taste the curry
odia:
କେତେ ଘାଣ୍ଟିବ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ
ତିଅଣ ସୁଆଦ କି ଜାଣିବ ଚଟୁ?
literal_meaning: Let it stir however much it will—can the ladle know the curry’s taste?
meaning_odia: ଚଟୁ ତିଅଣକୁ ଯେତେ ଘାଣ୍ଟିଲେ ବି ତାହାର ସୁଆଦ ଜାଣିପାରେ ନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, କେବଳ ପାଖରେ ରହିବା ବା ଏକ କାମକୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର କରିବାରୁ ତାହାର ମର୍ମ ବୁଝିହେବ ବୋଲି ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The ladle remains in contact with the food and keeps moving through it, yet cannot experience its flavour. This edition reads the image as a distinction between repeated involvement and understanding: going through the motions does not itself bring insight.
usage_example: A learner repeats a passage flawlessly but has not considered what it means. A teacher recalls the ladle and curry to encourage attention to meaning. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The kitchen utensil does the stirring while taste belongs to someone who can experience the dish. Repetition of the stirring verb sets up the final question, which exposes the difference between contact and comprehension.

english_summary: Repeated contact alone does not guarantee understanding.
